newsitem.title: UK: BS sets up research group for car industry.
newsitem.headline: BS sets up research group for car industry.

text.p: British Steel Plc launched plans for an internal research and development support group to serve the car industry at the British International Motor Show on Tuesday.
The company saw the team helping to develop lightweight steel for vehicles, in an effort to cut manufacturing costs.

Industry experts say the material can also contribute towards the development of more fuel-efficient vehicles, and could also be a counter to the growing competitive threat to steel's industry supremacy from aluminium.
The Automotive Engineering Group will support car makers and component makers and be staffed by 30 people. BS said the car industry represents around 20 percent of its total business.
The UK company's move comes at a time when car makers have been expecting higher standards and keen prices from steel suppliers.
Jeff Eddington, director of technology, said in a statement "We must be the supplier of choice and we must continuously improve our performance. The Group is a key step in achieving this."
